name: SC-17599
summary: SC-17599 is a steroid derivative drug discovered in 1968 which acts as a selective μ-opioid receptor agonist, with little or no affinity for the δ-opioid or κ-opioid receptors. It is an active analgesic in vivo, more potent than codeine or pethidine but slightly less potent than morphine, and produces similar effects to morphine in animals but with less sedation

pharmacology.text: SC-17599 is a steroid derivative drug discovered in 1968 which acts as a selective μ-opioid receptor agonist, with little or no affinity for the δ-opioid or κ-opioid receptors.

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids of this kind cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and itching, and in overdose can slow or stop breathing, which can be fatal. Regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類鴉片類藥物會引起嗜睡、噁心、便秘和搔癢，過量時可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止，可能致命。規律使用會導致依賴和戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类鸦片类药物会引起嗜睡、恶心、便秘和搔痒，过量时可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止，可能致命。规律使用会导致依赖和戒断症状。

fact.en: SC-17599 is remarkable for its shape: it is built on a steroid skeleton, like testosterone, yet it acts on the mu-opioid receptor like morphine.
fact.zh: SC-17599 的結構很特別：它以類固醇骨架為基礎，和睪固酮相似，卻像嗎啡一樣作用於 μ 鴉片受體。
fact.zhHans: SC-17599 的结构很特别：它以类固醇骨架为基础，和睾固酮相似，却像吗啡一样作用于 μ 鸦片受体。
